concerns.text: Task T025b ('Train and compare Coordinate-Randomized GNN') is placed in Phase 4 (US2) but depends on T025a ('Prepare coordinate-randomized dataset'). T025a is listed after T025b in the task list, violating the producer-before-consumer rule. The dataset preparation must precede the training task.

Task T023a ('Construct validation data loader') is listed after T023 ('Implement training loop'). The training loop (T023) logically requires the validation loader to be available for early stopping logic (T023b). While T023b is after T023a, T023 itself implies a dependency on the loader's existence. T023a should precede T023 to ensure the artifact (loader) exists before the consumer (loop) is defined.

Task T025b ('Train and compare Coordinate-Randomized GNN') is marked [P] (parallel-safe). However, it consumes the output of T025a (dataset preparation) and T020 (model architecture). If T025a and T020 are not completed, T025b cannot run. The [P] tag is misleading here as it implies independence from other US2 tasks, whereas it is strictly sequential within the ablation study workflow.
The ordering of T025a and T025b is reversed in the list. T025a (Prepare dataset) must be listed before T025b (Train) to reflect the data-flow dependency. Current order: T025b -> T025a.
